Embeddings and rerankers for search and retrieval: text, code, multimodal, contextualized chunks.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [dashboard.voyageai.com](https://dashboard.voyageai.com/organization/api-keys)
- **Setting:** `VOYAGE_API_KEY`
- **API reference:** [docs.voyageai.com](https://docs.voyageai.com/reference/embeddings-api)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Voyage AI and open [dashboard.voyageai.com](https://dashboard.voyageai.com/organization/api-keys).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** A secret key from the Voyage dashboard; the Gateway sends it as a bearer token. Apps POST to /v1/embeddings, /v1/multimodalembeddings, /v1/contextualizedembeddings and /v1/rerank.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Voyage%20AI) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
everyapp secret set VOYAGE_API_KEY
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  voyage: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"`. The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `everyapp provider show voyage` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.voyageai.com/v1/batches` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Cost:** voyage-4 $0.06 per million tokens; the first 200 million tokens of the voyage-4 family are free per account.
- **Rate limits:** 2000 a minute. 2,000 requests a minute at tier 1, doubled at tier 2, tripled at tier 3; tokens per minute vary by model.
